name: BluetoothConnectScreen
label: Bluetooth
description: Pair custom BLE hardware (Arduino Nano 33 BLE and friends) and bind its commands to PiHome events

settings.title: Enabled
settings.desc: Enable the Bluetooth service. When off, PiHome never powers the BLE radio

settings.title: Max Devices
settings.desc: Maximum simultaneous BLE connections (1-4). A Pi 3 shares its radio with WiFi, so keep this low

settings.title: Scan Duration
settings.desc: How long the discovery scan runs when you tap SCAN, in seconds (default 8)

settings.title: Command Debounce
settings.desc: Ignore a repeat of the same command from the same device within this many milliseconds (default 250)

settings.title: Notify On Command
settings.desc: Show a toast whenever a command arrives. Useful while setting up bindings

settings.title: Pair Key
settings.desc: Optional shared word. PiHome sends it on connect and ignores the device until it answers 'AUTH ok'. Sent in the clear over the air, so it only guards against accidental or casual connections

settings.title: Adapter
settings.desc: BlueZ adapter name on Linux, e.g. hci0. Leave blank for the default. Ignored on macOS

settings.title: Service UUID
settings.desc: Must match your sketch. Change it on both sides to isolate your devices from other PiHome installs

settings.title: TX Characteristic UUID
settings.desc: Notify characteristic the device sends commands on (device to PiHome)

settings.title: RX Characteristic UUID
settings.desc: Write characteristic PiHome sends text to (PiHome to device)

settings.title: Info Characteristic UUID
settings.desc: Optional read characteristic holding the device's friendly name
